message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

The change touches two files:

- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`** (new): adds the `nickname` column to `users`. I didn't edit 001 or 002 because they're already applied in production. The README says migrations are owned by the DBA team, so please have them review this file before it ships.
- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` takes `nickname` (default `null`) and stores it. `getUser` returns `nickname: r.nickname ?? null`.

I haven't committed anything.
